svg.title: Window III
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after an actually inspected identified primary photograph. The captioned Window III EK 2 is the right-hand work in the colour Philadelphia installation. White rectangular support, central vertical cord, upper paired horizontal lines, two shorter horizontal lines, lower paired cross-lines and lower zigzag cords follow the actually enlarged photograph. Very pale neutral lines diagram the shadows of WHITE cords; no gray pigment is asserted. Centre Pompidou curator Jean-Pierre Criqui independently describes Window III as a white monochrome with string sewn onto canvas. Line thickness and minor joins simplified; frame and wall excluded.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-paris-new-york-1949-1959/. Foundation catalogue EK 2. Visually inspected 2026-10-28. Pure editable vector; no embedded photograph.
